Football is my favourite game. It did not originate in our country. It originally came from England. Even so, it is my favourite game.

In Bangladesh, football is a well-known game and sport. Known for its enjoyment and the excitement you get while watching a football match, it is one of the most played games in Bangladesh. People from all ages and categories like football very much.

Football is my favourite game from my very childhood. I play it whenever I get time. I usually play it in the afternoon.

Football is played in a field, which is typically 120 meters long and 80 meters wide. The entire game is ninety-minutes, which is split into two parts. There are two teams, each team contains eleven players. The goal of each team is to score more by making the ball land on the goal post. There are two goal posts on either side of the yard, the playing team aims the ball at the opponent team’s goal post, while the goal keeper keeps the ball out.

There are many popular football players all over the world. The most known faces being Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi. Lionel Messi won the last Fifa world cup held in 2022. Besides, there are other talented players, one of them being Pele, known for scoring the most goals in football history.

Football has a number of merits. Football promotes physical fitness by improving strength, stamina, and overall health. It enhances mental sharpness and strategic thinking as players plan moves and anticipate opponents’ actions. The game also fosters teamwork, communication, and discipline since coordination among team members is essential for winning.

Football, while beneficial, has a few drawbacks. Injuries such as fractures, or muscle strains are common due to physical contact and intense play. Excessive competition can sometimes lead to stress, aggression, or unsportsmanlike behavior. It also demands a lot of time and energy, which might affect studies or other responsibilities.

I play football usually in the afternoon. On the weekends, I spend more time on it. I play football with my friends. But I try to avoid playing it before or during exams. I also avoid playing in the rain or if the field is muddy.

Everything has demerits, but my favourite game football has more merits than demerits. It is not just a game, it is an emotion. To me, football is not only a game but a passion that teaches teamwork, courage, and joy. The pleasure we get from playing and watching a football match is incomparable.

#Football, #Hobby
